feedback: The query does not restrict the inventory data to the end of December 2018, so the start_qty may not represent the required December 2018 ending inventory.
No date or period column is used on the inventory table to isolate December 2018 levels, violating step 1 of the Action Plan.
The start_qty aggregation sums all inventory records without a temporal filter, which can produce incorrect initial quantities.
If a product lacks a row in product_minimums, min_qty will be NULL, leading to incorrect calculations or NULL results.
